purpose: T7 Arm B stimuli. Scored on Kaggle T4s; rendered and checked here so a rendering bug does not cost a T4 session.
scope: all 1,000 items, 2 permutations, 3 framings, Format V base
confirmatory_subset: size tile, n = 108 with finite beta_c (P2-D3, P2-D4)
batch_rule: D102 part 3: the `size` tile is scored at max_batch = 1. P1 does this because size carries the primary curve and is where margins inside the fp16 noise floor sit. T7 inherits it, and size is also the confirmatory tile.
